capabilities: Detect scripture references and turn them into interactive links
Show NWT verse text, cross-references and study notes in a sidebar pane
Parse a selection or whole document into a searchable, sortable reference table
Insert full verse text as a citation in two formats
Reformat references between Full, Standard and Official name formats
disambiguation: Not a general text-search or traversal tool; it only finds, converts and displays scripture references.
extras: Verse text is fetched over the network and cached in memory for one hour; the README warns that unofficial forks exist and are unsupported, and notes that NWT text is copyrighted by Watch Tower Bible and Tract Society of Pennsylvania.
problem: Scripture references in notes stay plain text, so readers cannot see the verse, switch between book-name formats, or open a citation in JW Library without manual work.
summary: Scripture reference parser and viewer that links Bible citations in notes, shows NWT verse text in a sidebar, and reformats or expands references.
